lifecycleStatus.description: Lifecycle status of the project from inception to closure

oneOf.description: Pre-planning research and exploration to assess feasibility and scope; no formal approval yet.
Idea submitted for consideration; awaiting review and approval.
Decision made to proceed; resourcing and high-level scope confirmed.
Timelines, scope, and resources defined; execution not yet started.
Paused deliberately by decision; may resume later.
Cannot proceed due to external dependency, constraint, or unresolved risk.
All scoped work delivered and accepted.
Post-delivery upkeep, minor enhancements, and support.
Formal wind-down of deliverables and decommissioning.
Stopped before completion; no further work planned.
Finalized record retained; no changes expected.

healthStatus.description: Delivery health signal used for governance and reporting

oneOf.description: Progressing as planned with no material risks to scope, schedule, or quality.
Issues exist that could impact scope, schedule, or quality if not addressed; mitigation in progress.
Material slippage or issues; recovery plan required and/or approved baseline no longer valid.

owners.description: Owning parties for the project: Working Groups, Teams, or Persons

anyOf.description: A Working Group that owns the project
A Team that owns the project (schema to be defined)
An individual Person that owns the project
